categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes FinalizePSBT in src/psbt.cpp, which governs the output of the finalizepsbt RPC and is tested via test/functional/rpc_psbt.py without touching wallet code.
categories.rationale: Fixes an RPC correctness bug where finalizepsbt returns complete: true for transactions with invalid final scripts. As noted in the description, 'finalizepsbt can return complete: true and a hex for a PSBT whose PSBT_IN_FINAL_SCRIPTWITNESS (or final scriptSig) is invalid', outputting transactions that subsequently fail mempool verification and contradict analyzepsbt.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Per category guidelines, a PSBT change that affects only RPC without touching wallet code is rpc, not wallet.
categories.rationale: This PR touches src/psbt.cpp and test/functional/rpc_psbt.py without altering wallet logic or wallet RPCs.
